pages.setting: Magical carousel at a night fair surrounded by rides and glowing stalls
pages.mainAction: The horse stamps as the duck and rabbit demand different motions, awakening bumper cars and every light on the Ferris wheel while Leo leaps to intervene.
pages.lighting: Bright carnival lights against the night sky

pages.setting: Magical carousel and nearby pirate ship at the night fair
pages.mainAction: The carousel whirls rapidly while the pirate ship swings overhead, flinging stall hats as a cardboard moon lands on Leo and the rabbit bounds toward the trampolines.
pages.lighting: Swirling carnival lights with moonlit night shadows

pages.setting: Trampoline area among the awakened fairground attractions
pages.mainAction: The rabbit jumps over Leo, the horse races beneath him, and the duck rolls between his legs as nearby rides erupt and popcorn engulfs him.

pages.setting: Trampoline area amid the unsettled night fair
pages.mainAction: The child listens closely to each animal while Leo shakes popcorn from his ears and the group considers their different needs for wind, bouncing, and a gentle wave.
pages.lighting: Soft carnival light with the surrounding rides glowing

pages.setting: Open plaza directly in front of the carousel with straight, winding, and circular painted tracks
pages.mainAction: The child directs changing hand rhythms as the horse races the straight track, the rabbit bounds along the winding track, and the duck waddles around the circle while Leo escorts each safely.
pages.lighting: Warm stall lights with scattered firefly glimmers
continuityAnchors: same three animals following their preferred motions

pages.setting: Carousel platform beside its control levers and exposed music-box mechanism
pages.mainAction: A large brass wheel spins wildly as Leo poises a paw above it, the child places a hand across three levers, and the animals board their carousel mounts.
pages.lighting: Focused golden mechanism light within the glowing night fair
continuityAnchors: horse, rabbit, and duck have returned

pages.setting: Moving carousel overlooking the gradually quieting night fair
pages.mainAction: The child shifts the levers while Leo increases his gentle pressure on the brass wheel, easing the carousel from a gallop into soft bouncing and a nearly still wave as the fair shuts down.
pages.lighting: Carnival lights dimming progressively into calm night light

pages.setting: Motionless carousel in the now-quiet night fair
pages.mainAction: The resting animals settle on the stopped carousel as the child pats Leo’s relaxed paw, with the cardboard moon quiet on his lap and the final Ferris wheel light fading.
pages.lighting: Soft final carnival glow fading into peaceful moonlight
